source.title: SG-12 | Full E2E, threat/quality evaluation, runbook and REAL supplier-file pilot
source.body:
**Outcome:** deterministic reproducible evidence that entire supplier + catalog-intelligence block is fit to use, and a clear no-go if unknown external reality remains.

**Runbook/test coverage:** clean disposable DB schema/migrations/seed; Excel/CSV synthetic supplied fixtures incl price-only/partial/full, mapped/unmapped profile, unknown quantities, duplicate/ambiguous barcode+size, new brand/line/priority active ingredient, official/derived media, formula-aware routine, invalid and out-of-scope. Real supplier-scoped browser Upload→Profile→Rows→Offer + Candidate→Research/Entity knowledge→Content/Media→Review/Publish→Sourcing/PO. Prove response/body, DB before/after and audit; batch job/job resume under provider failure, validation/conflicts; concurrent/stale/duplicate/tenant cross-access; untrusted PDF/CSV formulas; malicious upload; workers and AI timeouts; no destructive snapshot; unknown cost not margin guarantee. Accessibility/responsiveness, API+UI typecheck/lint/full affected test regression/build.

**Provider evaluation:** check Exa/Firecrawl/model/image-generation keys/config in secret store without leaking them; quota/timeouts/caching/fallback; field fact provenance/confidence QA and false-match evaluation set. Operational telemetry/alerts only for actionable failures, job tracing, basic cost/latency per stage, replay/rollback/retention. One concise ops runbook and session handoff for future agents.

**Release gate:** owner-validated sanitized ORIGINAL export (at least one for each distinct launch supplier ERP/file layout), verified price/discount meaning and brand policy, catalog sample, approved logo/packshot source rights. Synthetic fixtures never count as real export evidence; mark BLOCKED if absent, don't invent success. Produce final PASS/FAIL per case and open blockers with exact next actions; parent master remains open until exit.

**Execution dependency:** blocked by AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#142. Complete and review previous gate before starting this stage.

**Additional Supplier completeness E2E:** proof of physical supplier return and subsequent approved credit netted against the NEXT supplier invoice, with gross new COGS, credit application, cash outflow and cross-month report not double-counted; unauthorized/duplicate/rejected credit cannot be applied.

## IMAGE GENERATION DEFERRED — revised MVP exit gate

Live Google/OpenAI paid image-generation smoke-test is **NOT REQUIRED for MVP Supplier+Catalog hard-gate completion** while image generation is explicitly feature-disabled. Instead prove that deferred/unconfigured provider response is truthful and recoverable; no fake output is published; genuine product packshot, official logo and permitted source media can be stored and reviewed; ProductCandidate can publish without optional ingredient/lifestyle illustration. The live model cost/quality comparison and external key/billing acceptance move to owner-approved production activation. Existing text asking for live model smoke applies only after that activation.

### Superseding image-generation acceptance — release without paid art

Current acceptance: real packshot/logo source & transform/storage, optional generated-media status NOT_GENERATED correctly reflected across UI/DB and no paid image API calls, failures or bills; test offline/provider-not-configured scenario. Remove image-generation paid provider smoke test and generated concept assets from mandatory pass criteria. Later production activation is a separately authorized decision and requires benchmark, key, spend ceiling, trademark/rights review. Free Cloudinary plan and Sharp can support **processing** but do NOT fabricate new images. Other research/content APIs must be audited separately.
